prompt: What is the name of the Australian novelist who is one of only five writers to have won the Booker Prize twice and also won the Jerusalem Prize?
answer: The novelist is **J. M. Coetzee**. Born in South Africa, Coetzee later became an Australian citizen; he won the Booker Prize twice and also received the Jerusalem Prize.
